what: A standing declarative loop. A node whose whole body is (trigger, method-pointer, why, sources/targets) — it runs continuously, collecting or transforming data. Requires no new code: it WIRES a proven method (a sensor or transform already in proven-space, via the method-registry) to a trigger and owned targets. ITS RESTING STATE IS AN OPEN RULING — see `open_ruling` below. The clause that stood here until 2026-07-30 read 'and whose resting state is LEARNING'; ticket watchme-emits-a-probe dissolved LEARNING as a node state, and this class is the one place in the system that depended on it.
why: Most of what a device DOES — collect metrics, watch a threshold, alarm, fold artifacts into trees — is not bespoke per-device code but the same loop with different fields. Making it a declarative node kind means behavior is specified as data and run by one generic executor (candidate: the ground_loop), so there is no uninstrumented daemon left to rot silently (the UU disease). There is no 'just running' in Cairn: everything runs through instrumented chokepoints, so everything running emits evidence, so everything running is learning (low-yield running = low-yield learning, a YIELD MEASURE, not a state — which, in hindsight, is exactly why it never needed one). The graph-tree harvester and the 'sleep' consolidation are themselves operational-drivers — the primitive is self-hosting.
prove_gate: proof gate — the tester proves the wired loop actually collects/transforms what its why claims (the sensor reads, the target fills) and emits a VALIDATION. IOU: tester not built; hand-proven per the node's proofs/ until then.
extra_gates: method-registry gate — the method-pointer MUST resolve to a PROVEN method already in proven-space; a driver introduces no new code, it only wires proven primitives (Law 8). owned-target gate — writes to sources/targets route through each target's owner's gate (Law 6), never ambiently.
kicks_back_on: red proof (the loop does not produce what its why claims, or a target write is refused by its owner) → routes back to design/build at the point of creation (CP2). Never terminal: a driver can be superseded or edited (the workflow is a mutable string — a code node becomes a driver, or a driver is retired, by editing its terminal), each edit owner-gated, chokepoint-validated, and journaled. NB the terminal a code node would be edited TO is the same vacancy `open_ruling` names.

open_ruling.question: What is an operational-driver's resting state, now that the dissolved fifth summons — the terminal this class was to be edited INTO — no longer exists?
open_ruling.why_it_is_recorded_and_not_answered: A class definition is ratified by Akien's signature gate (node_classes/_charter+why.json: 'a class definition is ratified by Akien'). The DISSOLUTION of LEARNING is his ruling and is applied here without asking. What REPLACES the clause is a design decision, and answering it silently would be the drift where his own terms survive while their meanings are swapped underneath them. Silence is the failure the ticket named; a guess dressed as a charter is the worse one.
open_ruling.measured_state_of_the_class: `members_so_far` is EMPTY and this file registers no `workflow_versions`, so no node is at sea under this class and nothing is broken by the vacancy. Measured 2026-07-30 by the v2 migration sweep, which had to SCOPE ITSELF to classes carrying a registered v2 precisely because this one (with concept-piece and host-seam) carries none — a pre-existing gap this ticket pinned by name rather than fixed.
candidates: THE CLASS RETIRES INTO THE PROBE PRIMITIVE. A probe (cairn/base/probe.py) already IS (trigger, method-pointer, why, carrier/target) — immutable, authority-free, outliving the crossing that emitted it. If that is the whole content of this class, the class is a duplicate and should be SUPERSEDED, not repaired. Evidence for: the probe was built without needing this class, and MAP.md already says 'the declarative-data idea survives, but as the PROBE species now'.

IT KEEPS A REST UNDER A NEW NAME. If a driver really is a NODE (mutable, ownable, kick-backable) and not a probe, it needs a rest that is not PROVED, and the name must be derivable from its native-domain use rather than memorized. Evidence for: `kicks_back_on` above describes node behaviour a probe does not have.
IT WAS NEVER A NODE-CLASS — a probe-with-a-charter, i.e. the charter belongs to whatever OWNS the probe, and this file is a category error from 2026-07-17 that nothing has yet exercised.
open_ruling.what_would_settle_it: The first real member. This class has never had one; the question is unanswerable from the armchair and cheap to answer the moment something wants to be an operational-driver. Until then the vacancy is loud here and in MAP.md, and costs nothing.
open_ruling.narrowed_2026_08_03: Akien's ruling: "whatever says the classes have to carry a workflow is wrong — a workflow is composed at ticketing time by the ticketer based on the needs of the ticket." That does NOT answer this question; it removes the thing that made the vacancy look like a defect. This class registering no workflow_versions is now the CORRECT shape, not a gap (`measured_state_of_the_class` above reads it as a pre-existing gap — that reading is superseded). The question that survives is narrower and unchanged in kind: is this a node species at all, or the probe primitive wearing a charter? Still settled by the first real member, still Akien's signature gate.

provenance: cast 2026-07-17 in the node state-machine design session (see tickets/state-machine-physics), when 'tickets as operational drivers' generalized the graph-tree learning into a primitive: LEARNING was one configured driver among many (metrics, alarms). Ratified by Akien (signature gate) 2026-07-17 ('I think we're done, yes. CC++'). AMENDED 2026-07-30 (ticket watchme-emits-a-probe piece (e-ii)): LEARNING dissolved as a node state; the dead clause is struck from `what` and the vacancy it leaves is recorded in `open_ruling` above, awaiting the signature gate. The original clause is quoted in `what` rather than deleted — a record of truth is never edited to hide the shape it used to have (Law 7).
